name: Iola
title: Dumpster rental prices in Iola
description: Published dumpster rental prices for companies that name Iola, TX. Each price links to the company page and shows the day it was checked.
summary: These companies name Iola on their own pages. None of them published an Iola price that differs from the rate page. Published base prices run from $295 to $595. BCS Junk Removal and Rocking H Dumpsters posted those dollar prices, checked Nov 26, 2026. BVR Waste and Recycling and Texas Commercial Waste name Iola and did not post a dollar price. Those pages were checked Nov 28, 2026. Sort by price, size, or days.

faqs.question: How much does a dumpster cost in Iola?
faqs.answer: Published base prices from companies that name Iola run from $295 to $595. Rocking H Dumpsters lists a 10-yard roll-off at $295 for up to 10 days, checked Nov 26, 2026. The 40-yard is $595 for up to 10 days. BCS Junk Removal lists a 15-yard at $380 for 3 days and $420 for 7 days. The dump fee is $60 per ton. No page printed a separate Iola rate.

faqs.question: Which companies posted a price and name Iola?
faqs.answer: BCS Junk Removal and Rocking H Dumpsters posted rental prices, and both name Iola. BVR Waste and Recycling names Iola in the areas menu and does not post a dollar price. Texas Commercial Waste names Iola on the homepage service area list and does not post a dollar price. Those rows say Call for quote.

faqs.question: Did Rocking H publish a different Iola price?
faqs.answer: No. The item pages list one price for each size, and the service area list includes Iola. Tonnage is $32 or $73 per ton, and the page does not say which rate applies. A fuel surcharge is based on distance, and the amount is not published. Included tons are not stated.

faqs.question: Does the BCS price cover Iola?
faqs.answer: The dumpster page lists $380 for 3 days and $420 for 7 days. The locations list names Iola along with College Station, Bryan, Navasota, Brenham, Caldwell, and Somerville. It does not print a separate Iola price. Included tons are not stated. The dump fee is $60 per ton.

faqs.question: What does Call for quote mean?
faqs.answer: The company has a public page that names Iola, and that page does not list a dollar price. Use the phone number on the company row. This site does not fill one in.

faqs.question: What does Not listed mean?
faqs.answer: That fact was not on the company page. A row can show a verified price and still say Not listed for days, tons, tax, or an extra fee.
